mapper.sql: a.achievement_id, a.management_no, a.teacher_user_id, u.login_id AS teacher_name, a.organization_code, a.evaluation_year, a.management_item_code, a.achievement_date, a.achievement_status, d.special_lecture_start_date, d.special_lecture_end_date, d.mock_exam_question_period, a.attachment_ref, a.created_at, a.updated_at
FROM education_achievements a JOIN employment_rate_improvement_achievement_details d ON d.achievement_id = a.achievement_id JOIN users u ON u.user_id = a.teacher_user_id
mapper.select: SELECT p.organization_code FROM users u JOIN korus_personnel_snapshots p ON p.employee_no = u.employee_no JOIN organizations o ON o.organization_code = p.organization_code WHERE u.user_id = #{userId} AND o.status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM evaluation_management_items m WHERE m.management_item_code = #{code} AND m.active_yn = 'Y'
mapper.update: UPDATE education_achievements SET management_item_code = #{code}, achievement_date = #{date}, attachment_ref = #{attachments}, updated_by = #{userId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, request_id = #{requestId} WHERE achievement_id = #{id} AND achievement_type = 'FR-029' AND teacher_user_id = #{userId} AND deleted_yn = 'N' AND achievement_status IN ('DRAFT', 'DEPARTMENT_REJECTED', 'CERTIFICATION_REJECTED')

UPDATE employment_rate_improvement_achievement_details SET special_lecture_start_date = #{start}, special_lecture_end_date = #{end}, mock_exam_question_period = #{period}, updated_by = #{userId}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE achievement_id = #{id}
